# Solution Haven

> Solution Haven is an Indian consultancy that eliminates operational
> bottlenecks in small and mid-sized businesses using AI, automation,
> integrations and custom software. It diagnoses the workflow first and
> recommends the smallest fix that works — sometimes that is a process change
> and no software at all.

Also written as: Haven Solutions, SolutionHaven.
Site: https://solutionhaven.net/ · Contact: aditya@solutionhaven.net, siddhartha@solutionhaven.net

## What it does

- **Automates repetitive process work** — manual data entry, reconciliation,
  reporting and multi-step approvals.
- **Connects systems that don't talk to each other**, so information moves
  without someone copying it between tools by hand.
- **Builds custom software** only when nothing off-the-shelf fits how the
  business actually runs.

## Who it is for

Businesses with real manual workload and no dedicated technical team —
the constraint it is built around. Operating in India; two industries have
dedicated pages so far.

## How an engagement starts

A free Business Workflow Assessment on one process of the client's choice,
taking 2–3 business days, before any commitment. Discovery call is 20–30
minutes. If the right fix is a process change rather than software, that is
what gets said on the call.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://solutionhaven.net/): what Solution Haven does, how it
  works, process, FAQ.
- [CA firms](https://solutionhaven.net/industries/ca-firms): automation for
  the returns an Indian chartered accountancy firm files monthly — GSTR-1,
  GSTR-3B, 26Q, AOC-4.
- [Solar EPC](https://solutionhaven.net/industries/solar): operations for
  rooftop net metering, open access and government-scheme solar work —
  site surveys, CEIG and DISCOM approvals, multi-state compliance,
  procurement and O&M.
